note: BCEAO national directorate for Benin. The one BCEAO document that lists all lots (centralised accounting plus every national directorate) is 'Avis de publication de resultats - RESULTATS DE LA DEMANDE DE PROPOSITIONS RELATIVE A LA SELECTION DE CABINETS CHARGES DU CONTROLE EXTERNE DES COMPTES DE LA COMPTABILITE CENTRALISEE ET DES DIRECTIONS NATIONAL.pdf' at bceao.int/sites/default/files/inline-files/. WebFetch refuses it with 'url exceeds the maximum fetchable length' (the URL is 364 characters) - this is a URL-length limit, not a document-length limit, so offsets cannot help; a second, equally long results notice at /files/2024-01/ (369 characters) is refused for the same reason. The short-URL award notice at /files/2024-08/ covers Niger only (902 characters of text, confirmed by an offset read). The BCEAO 2024 IFRS financial statements name only Deloitte Cote d'Ivoire as Commissaire Controleur and no directorate-level firms. French searches for the award notices returned only these same two over-length PDFs.
BCEAO national directorate for Burkina Faso - same blocker as BEN: the only document listing the directorate lots has a 364-character URL that WebFetch rejects as over the maximum fetchable length.
BCEAO national directorate for Cote d'Ivoire (distinct from the union accounts audited by Deloitte Cote d'Ivoire) - same blocker as BEN.
BCEAO national directorate for Guinea-Bissau - same blocker as BEN.
BCEAO national directorate for Mali - same blocker as BEN.
BCEAO national directorate for Togo - same blocker as BEN.

Central Bank of Jordan. Searches for a CBJ annual report or financial statements naming an audit firm returned only commercial Jordanian banks' reports (Cairo Amman Bank, Bank of Jordan, JKB) and unrelated government open-data files. No CBJ document naming its auditor was located.

National Bank of Rwanda. Searches for Law 48/2017 governing the BNR and its audit article returned only gazette aggregators (regalert.today, commons.laws.africa) with no retrievable text of the audit article, and no document naming an audit firm. Not attempted by fetch; budget exhausted on higher-yield targets.
National Bank of Ethiopia. Proclamation 591/2008 art. 8 requires an annually appointed external auditor but names no firm; no NBE financial statements naming the firm were located, so no record.

Qatar Central Bank. Searches for a QCB independent auditor's report returned only Qatari commercial banks (Commercial Bank, Doha Bank, Dukhan, ahlibank). QCB does not appear to publish audited financial statements naming an auditor; nothing found.

Central Bank of the Republic of Armenia. The CBA Annual Report 2022 PDF (cba.am/EN/pperiodicals/Annual_Report_2022.pdf, 326,892 characters) was read at offsets 0-100,000 and 200,000-300,000; the independent auditor's report falls in the unread 100,000-200,000 band. News items exist claiming KPMG and Grant Thornton audits in different years (centralbanking.com, banks.am) but none was fetched or confirmed, so no firm is recorded.

National Bank of Georgia. The NBG Annual Report 2020 PDF is 774,993 characters and the financial statements begin around page 254; the fetch returned characters 0-100,000 only, which does not reach the auditor's report, and no standalone NBG financial-statements PDF naming a firm was found in search.

Central Bank of Azerbaijan. Search returned only unlabelled uploads.cbar.az asset PDFs (hash filenames) and the Law on the Central Bank; no document could be identified in advance as containing the auditor's report, and none was fetched.

Central Bank of Uzbekistan. The CBU Annual Report 2023 PDF was fetched (characters 0-100,000 of 359,552): the only audit firm mentioned is PwC in the acronyms list, with no statement that PwC audits the Central Bank. No auditor named in the readable portion.
National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic. Search returned only nbkr.kg numeric-ID PDFs with no identifiable titles, so no document could be targeted; not fetched.
National Bank of Tajikistan. Not reached - fetch budget exhausted on higher-yield targets.

National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia. Two exact documents from search results - 'Independent-Auditor's-Report-and-Financial-Statement-of-the-National-Bank_2023.pdf' and 'Report_on_the_Audit_Committee_Operations_for_2024_(summary).pdf', both on www.nbrm.mk:443/content/ - each failed with a site-side client_error and nothing was retrieved.

Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina. A mirrored copy of the CBBH Annual Report 2024 on ticaret.gov.tr failed with a target server error; the CBBH site's own audit-chapter and auditor's-report filings do not name the firm on their listing pages.

Banco Central del Paraguay. Searches in Spanish for BCP audited financial statements or an external-audit dictamen returned only Paraguayan commercial banks' balances and a news item about the Contralor alleging BCP obstruction of an audit; no source naming who audits the BCP.

Banco de Guatemala. The Bank's published Estados Financieros 2024 state only that the statements were 'verificados por auditor independiente' and cite article 62 of the organic law as the basis for publication; no firm and no Contraloria General de Cuentas is named. A requirement without a named auditor is not a record.

Central Bank of Belize. The standalone financial statements fs-2019.pdf were fetched: 'Independent Auditors' Report' appears as a heading and in the contents, but the report's text and signature block are not in the extractable text (apparently an image), so no firm name could be read.

Bank of Guyana. The Annual Report 2019 (457,886 characters) was fetched at characters 0-100,000: the Governor's transmittal letter states the auditors were 'appointed in accordance with Section 60 of the Bank of Guyana Act 1998' but does not name them, and the auditor's report in Part VI falls outside the fetched range.

Central Bank of Barbados. The 2019 Annual Report was fetched at characters 100,000-200,000: the auditors' report signature block shows only 'Chartered Accountants', Bridgetown, Barbados, dated March 26, 2020 - the firm's name is not in the extractable text (apparently a graphic signature).

Central Bank of The Bahamas. The 2022 Annual Report and Financial Statements (346,864 characters) was fetched at characters 0-100,000 and 150,000-250,000; the Independent Auditors' Report, listed at page 54, was not in either range and no firm name was read.

Bank of Jamaica. The our.today article 'BOJ and JMB certified by Auditor General' states only that BOJ submitted audited financial statements under the Public Bodies Management and Accountability Act and that the Auditor General's Department used them in an assessment; it does not say who performs the audit. No other source naming BOJ's auditor was reached.

Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago (contested case). The CBTT Annual Report 2024 was fetched at characters 85,000-185,000: an Independent Auditor's Report addressed 'To the Board of Directors, Central Bank of Trinidad and Tobago' exists, signed at Port-of-Spain on December 18, 2024 for the year ended September 30, 2024, and it notes the prior year's statements 'were audited by another auditor' - but the signing firm's name is not in the extractable text, so no auditor can be recorded.
